notes: Design is named as an outbreak; cases were found through routine surveillance investigation. The comparison with Hurricane Irma (six cases, about one sixth) and Katrina (22 cases) is context drawn from earlier events, not the headline. The 5-year median baseline and percent increase are arithmetic, not procedures.
view_issues: The stated 1,100% increase does not match 38 vs 3 expected cases (about 1,167%). The baseline covers weeks 40–41, but cases are counted through October 23. CFR is given as both 29% and 28.9%.
